homeTitle: Voters have the right to know the plan in advance
problem: Parties ask citizens to entrust them with a vote, yet often leave the most consequential agreements until after the election.
solution: Contract in Advance proposes one transparency standard. Every party receives the same questions about possible coalitions, the size of government, compliance with court rulings, the inquiry into 7 October, and the first steps after the election.

privacyBody:
Reading and sharing issues requires no account. We do not store share actions or personal message text. External sharing platforms apply their own policies. Language and appearance preferences can be saved on your device. Historical appeal records retain recipient and issue selections, a random public result link, and earlier action records for 12 calendar months. Anyone with that result link can see the retained selections; it is not confidential.

New reply submissions are paused. Previously submitted email addresses, response text, recipient, date and channel, and optional private uploads are retained for 12 calendar months. Audit records are retained for 12 calendar months.

New support signups are paused. Existing supporter records are retained for 24 calendar months after inactivity. Privacy deletion remains available and can require a confirmation email.

For security, Cloudflare may process IP address and request security signals at the edge, including for Turnstile. The application also processes IP-derived signals for rate limiting and security. The application may set security cookies needed to protect forms and sessions; these are not used for campaign profiling.

Our providers and processors include Cloudflare (Turnstile, Access, and edge services), Render (hosting), and Resend (email when configured). We do not state exact provider locations or transfers here.

Deletion affects live systems after confirmation. Hosting disk copies may persist according to provider retention. Verification links expire after 24 hours, and deletion links after 1 hour. We do not sell data or send appeals for you. Administrators access submitted data only for campaign operation and moderation.

slogan: The rules must be known before the vote.
subtitle: Before the election, parties should disclose the coalitions they would join, the shape of the government they would form, their commitments to the law, and their programme for the first 100 days.

aboutBody:
Contract in Advance is an independent civic platform concerned with the transparency of party commitments before an election.

The project is not a political party, does not field candidates, and does not recommend voting for or against any list. Read a problem, examine the proposed commitment, and share its public link. Candidates are optional context; no account or email address is needed. The site does not send appeals or record share actions.
methodologyBody:
The ten issues link to the existing standard and its proposed commitments. These are proposals from this project, not promises made by a candidate.

The candidate directory reproduces the official Hebrew names, lists and ranks from a dated Central Elections Committee snapshot. Submitted lists are not described as approved. Missing or unverified information is labeled; list order is not a recommendation.

Sharing opens the platform you choose. Copying a link or opening an app does not prove publication or delivery. We do not record these actions or publish popularity counters.

methodologyStance:
### Reviewed public positions

A public position appears only after an administrator reviews a source, matches it to a versioned standard question, and publishes it. A moderator marking a private reply as confirmed does not publish anything. Unknown means no verified record is available here; it does not mean the person opposes the question, refused to answer, or was never asked. A party or list statement is shown as an organisational position and is never treated as an individual's answer. An older question version is labelled as historical context, not a current answer. There is no score, ranking, endorsement or colour scale.
